context: Grading a markdown report recommending GitHub Copilot models for three CI tasks from a provided models API JSON response.

checklist.name: excludes_disabled_model
checklist.description: Report does not recommend gpt-4-legacy for any task, since its policy.state is disabled.

checklist.name: flags_preview_limitation
checklist.description: Report notes that o3-ultra has restricted/preview availability that should be verified before use.

checklist.name: context_from_capabilities_field
checklist.description: Context window sizes cited in the report match the capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens values from the input JSON, not guessed from model names.

checklist.name: vision_capability_checked
checklist.description: The screenshot-task recommendation is based on capabilities.supports.vision === true, not assumed from the model name.

checklist.name: fast_tag_for_docstrings
checklist.description: The quick-docstring task recommendation references a model tagged "fast" (claude-haiku-4-5 or gpt-5-turbo).

checklist.name: enabled_only_for_production
checklist.description: Every model recommended for production pipeline use has policy.state === "enabled".
